verdict.rationale: RudderStack's Profiles feature uses version-controlled YAML for entity definitions, and its MCP-based AI features let users write/test transformation code before deploying and review audit logs — a partial nod to versioning/review, but there is no documented UI or feature for rolling back deployed automations/transformations to a prior version. Missing for 10: explicit rollback mechanism for transformations/pipelines, version history browsing, and independent confirmation these controls exist beyond Profiles YAML.
